messages:
maria_sales: Quick presales ask from FinBank EU \u2014 they require BYO-CMK, automated rotation every 45 days, 7y log retention, and an emergency rollback path. Need a short note on architecture options + perf impact we can share with their security team.
jo_solutions: Recommend envelope encryption: Redwood generates ephemeral data keys under customer's CMK; data keys cached in runtime and rewrapped at rotation. This keeps per-request latency low and satisfies audit scope because CMK ops are logged.
eli_security: For SOW include rotation cadence (45d), attestation delivery (monthly), key retention policy (keep old keys for 90d), rollback runbook, and log retention SLA (7y). Customer must provide KMS credentials and whitelist Redwood endpoints.
ben_sre: Perf: naive per-request CMK decrypt adds 5-25ms tail and increases KMS billing. Envelope approach: <1ms overhead per request since we cache data keys; CMK calls happen at rotation/first-derive and during canary rewraps. For high QPS recommend batching rewraps and a small LRU cache.
maria_sales: They asked "what happens if a rotation fails mid-rollout?"
jo_solutions: Add canary: 5% traffic for 30m, monitor error rate and latency. Automatic rollback to previous key if errors >0.5% or latency up >30ms. Documented manual rollback steps in SOW.
maria_sales: Also need a short customer-facing blurb to email security.
jo_solutions: Draft blurb: "Redwood supports customer-managed keys (BYO-CMK) using HSM-backed KMS providers. We recommend envelope encryption: ephemeral data keys are derived under your CMK and cached by Redwood's runtime, limiting CMK calls to rotation and initial derivation. This preserves cryptographic separation and audit logs while minimizing per-request latency and provider billing. For customers requiring per-request CMK operations, Redwood can enable per-call decrypts at the cost of added latency and KMS charges; this can be included in the SOW with rollback and retention terms."
maria_sales: Great — I'll send and flag if they want pricing for both modes.
ops-bot: Note created: /presales/1718801234-byo-cmk-options for follow-up.
eli_security: One more: include pen-test window and key ceremony contact in the onboarding checklist.
maria_sales: Thanks team :thumbsup:
